outcome: causes of cesarean hysterectomy (e.g., abnormal placentation, uterine rupture)
complications of cesarean hysterectomy (e.g., bladder injury, fever, ureteral injury, hematoma)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 82 women who underwent cesarean hysterectomy at Afzali Pour Hospital between 2018 and 2022.
finding: Placenta accreta and previa were the most frequent causes of cesarean hysterectomy, while bladder injury was the most common complication, and higher BMI and a greater number of previous cesarean sections significantly increased the odds of complications.
mod_finding: A higher number of previous cesarean sections significantly increased the likelihood of complications during cesarean hysterectomy.
